@kbn/eslint/module_migration.disallowedMessage: Don't use 'mkdirp', use the new { recursive: true } option of Fs.mkdir instead
Don't use idx(), use optional chaining syntax instead https://ela.st/optchain
Don't import monaco directly, use or add exports to @kbn/monaco
import from the root of @kbn/test instead
Prefer using @emotion/react instead. To use styled-components, ensure you plugin is enabled in packages/kbn-babel-preset/styled_components_files.js.
Use `@kbn/react-query` instead of `@tanstack/react-query`, as it defaults to networkMode="always"
Do not use 'elastic-apm-node' for new instrumentation. Use withActiveSpan from @kbn/tracing-utils instead.
Use the `yaml` package instead of js-yaml (e.g. `import yaml from 'yaml'`).
